mechanism: Foscarnet causes dose-dependent nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair renal function and increase risk of hyperkalemia when combined with ARB-mediated potassium retention.
action: Monitor serum creatinine, electrolytes (especially potassium and calcium), and blood pressure closely; consider alternative antiviral if possible or reduce telmisartan dose; ensure adequate hydration during foscarnet therapy.
